rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for ignorance or a lack of knowledge, often with a mildly negative tone.

example.english: Their ignorance of social manners often offends people.
example.traditional: 佢對人情世故嘅無知，成日得罪人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 cing4 sai3 gu3 ge3 mou4 zi1 seng4 jat6 dak1 zeoi6 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a neutral, specific lack of knowledge rather than the broader or more critical sense of 無知.

example.english: My ignorance in this area is why I want to look it up first.
example.traditional: 我對呢方面知識不足，所以想先查清楚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ne1 fong1 min6 zi3 sik1 bat1 zuk1 so2 ji5 soeng2 sin1 caa4 cing1 co2
